text: 澜沧江－湄公河合作第十一次外长会在北京举行。会后，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅同共同主席国泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨共同会见记者。 六国外长一致同意，澜湄合作由十年前的一粒种子，已成长为如今的参天大树，得益于六国坚持睦邻友好、命运与共的初心，坚持聚焦发展、务实合作的方向，坚持利民惠民、开放包容的理念，坚持创新驱动、先行先试的勇气。面对当前国际地区多重挑战，澜湄大家庭要以着眼开好澜湄合作第五次领导人会议为契机，推动澜湄合作继续迈上新台阶。
text_en: The 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' Meeting was held in Beijing. After the meeting, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi and Thai Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow, co-chair of the meeting, jointly met with the press. The six foreign ministers agreed that LMC, from a seed ten years ago, has grown into a towering tree today, thanks to the six countries' commitment to good-neighborliness and a shared future, to focusing on development and practical cooperation, to the philosophy of benefiting the people and openness and inclusiveness, and to the courage of innovation-driven and pioneering exploration. In the face of multiple current international and regional challenges, the LMC family should take the opportunity of convening the fifth LMC Leaders' Meeting to push LMC cooperation to a new level.
